payments.title: Payment methods
payments.description: Payment methods linked to your account.
payments.body: Payment method management will be enabled once the payment service is available. No financial data is requested or stored on this screen.

security.totpDescription: Add an authenticator app (TOTP) as a second factor.

totp.enrollFailed: The authenticator setup could not start.
totp.confirmFailed: The authenticator could not be confirmed.
totp.codeFormat: The code must have six digits.

totp.intro: Add an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.) as a second factor. It is required before receiving an administrative role.
totp.scan: Scan the QR code with your app, or enter the key manually. Then type the six-digit code it shows to confirm.
totp.qrAlt: QR code to set up your authenticator app

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.receivedBody: We will process it within 30 days at most. Receiving your request does not mean your account has already been deleted; when processing finishes you will receive a closure notice.
deletion.intro: Request the deletion of your account. The request is processed within 30 days at most: receiving it does not mean your account has already been deleted. When the process finishes, you will receive a closure notice.

deletion.failed: Your deletion request could not be sent. Please try again later.
deletion.confirmQuestion: Do you confirm you want to request the deletion of your account?
deletion.onlyOwn: This request applies only to your own account.

registration.emailHint: We will use this email to confirm your account.

registration.passwordHint: More than 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase, number and symbol.
registration.securityDescription: They will be used to recover access to your account. Answer all four.

questions.first-pet: What was the name of your first pet?
questions.birth-city: What is the name of the city where you were born?
questions.parents-city: What is the name of the city where your parents met?
